summary: Implemented enabledWorkers-aware executor dispatch: added ExecuteGoalParams.enabledWorkers, resolved effective workers with default both, switched default CLI backend to sole enabled worker when configured, clamped disabled CLI step backends to the sole enabled worker, limited degraded-planner step rewrites to codex-enabled runs, and instantiated CliTaskRunner only for enabled workers (PI still always instantiated). Threaded enabledWorkers through executeGoalWithAgent callers in goal and goal-resume commands. Added executor tests for codex-only clamp, claude-only clamp, both-enabled preserved routing, and degraded planner behavior when codex is disabled. Verification: pnpm build, pnpm vitest run src/goal/, pnpm lint, pnpm vitest run src/commands/goal.test.ts src/commands/goal-resume.test.ts, and CLI runtime path via node scripts/run-node.mjs goal resume in isolated MOLTBOT_STATE_DIR.
